WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT o.orderspivot, o.recordvault AS ordersmark, o.timespan,
         AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_fill
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN orderexecutions AS e ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.orderspivot, o.recordvault, o.timespan
), ranked AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, timespan, average_fill,
         AVG(average_fill) OVER (PARTITION BY timespan) AS time_in_force_average,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY average_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS fill_rank
  FROM order_averages
)
SELECT ordersmark, timespan, average_fill,
       average_fill - time_in_force_average AS amount_above_average,
       fill_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE average_fill > time_in_force_average
  AND fill_rank <= 3;
